speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two candles, and it is three in the afternoon. I can see them from the stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The porch is gone. The close ends at the window.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then write by those two, and do not ask me for a third. Your sixpence is the firing.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I shut the street door. The fog comes in when the latch is up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it shut. The cat is on the Chaucer, and I am not moving him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Let the beast sleep, then. I am not lighting a third candle so a cat can be admired.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I bring the loaf up?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it below. I have two lines I do not trust, and bread will not mend them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then come down when you are hungry. The pot is the ordinary one. I am not climbing this stair again to count your lights.
